highlights.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
highlights.summary: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

highlights.title: Girl rescued by free-climbing neighbour from balcony in Turkiye
highlights.summary: A man scaled a building to rescue a girl dangling from a 3rd floor balcony in the Turkish city of Diyarbakir.

highlights.title: Hong Kong Pro-Democracy Activist Joshua Wong Pleads Guilty to Collusion
